title: Why We Ship: Raposa Coffee
description:
From surviving one of the biggest rugs to winning the People's Award at Breakpoint. Andrew built Raposa Coffe to give back to the ecosystem, not extract from it.

asr.full_text: In an instant in this space, you can lose trust. That led me to my worst moment and my best moment, I think. My best learning experience, I should say. I decided to take a job as a community manager for a new project that was launching that was extremely hyped. It was called Balloonsville, which is now notoriously one of the biggest rugs that happened on Solana. Right the day after Mint, the founders disappeared. Even though it wasn't me, I was getting death threats to a point where I put out a post on Twitter, and I was like, hey, this is me, this is my ID. I'm here. I'm here to make things right. I worked on that for two years, but it's time to now use what I've learned to do something that I believe in, and that's my own idea. And that's how we ended up at Reposa. We wanted to build something that's tangible, that we can actually give back to the ecosystem versus extract from it. And what's more tangible than coffee? This past break point we won the People's Award for Reposa coffee. The ecosystem was able to go for us, and winning that award I think kind of was a full circle moment. The New York builder community is just vibrant and it's extremely supportive. We were able to do the first US Accelerate last year with six coffee booths. We'll have four coffee booths at this Accelerate. And I think it's just something really special, one of the best ideas in terms of a conference that Solana's had, right there next to Breakpoint. And my care to give back to the Solana ecosystem is a lot bigger than myself. It's a lot bigger than Reposa as just a brand. But it's about community and, you know, supporting one another through the entire process. I hope they understand that I never left, I think is the biggest thing.

The educational and entertainment framing, securities-offer disclaimer, and Solana Accelerate closing frame do not establish a transaction or promised return.
